stories.title: Contagio da Francia fa balzare spread con Bund a 118 punti in chiusura

en.title: Contagion from France pushes spread with Bund to 118 points at close
en.summary: Italian bond market spreads widened as concerns from France affected sentiment, while US 10-year Treasury yields remained elevated around 5.34%, marking their highest levels since 2002.

stories.title: Fonti Chigi, Meloni dispiaciuta per l'assenza di Salis sul palco del Salone nautico

en.title: Sources: Meloni disappointed by Salis's absence from boat show stage
en.summary: The Italian Premier expressed displeasure at the absence of a figure from a boat show event, having been informed it resulted from an organizational error.

stories.title: Lo spread Btp-Bund corre oltre 118 punti base

en.title: BTP-Bund spread surges beyond 118 basis points
en.summary: Italian government bond yields rose relative to German benchmarks as spreads widened significantly.

stories.title: Protesta degli studenti in Francia: preside attaccato in Marsiglia. Le Pen accusa Mélenchon

en.title: Student protests in France: principal attacked in Marseille. Le Pen accuses Mélenchon
en.summary: Student demonstrations started over a week ago in Paris suburbs protesting teacher shortages and inadequate public school resources have expanded and grown more violent, prompting the premier to convene an emergency cabinet meeting.

stories.title: Tetto ai carburanti, Tamoil segue Eni, Q8 e IP: misure di contenimento fino al 31 ottobre

en.title: Fuel price cap, Tamoil follows Eni, Q8 and IP: containment measures until 31 October
en.summary: Tamoil announced price containment measures for fuel until the end of October, joining other major fuel distributors in responding to extraordinary international conditions affecting household purchasing power.

stories.title: Sentenza Regeni, Meloni: "Siamo solo al primo grado". La famiglia: "Provvisionale già esecutiva"

en.title: Regeni verdict, Meloni: "We are only at first instance". The family: "Provisional damages already enforceable"
en.summary: Three Egyptian intelligence officers were convicted for kidnapping researcher Giulio Regeni but not for murder. Prime Minister Meloni defended diplomatic discretion while opposition parties called for action toward Cairo.

stories.title: Carburanti, anche Tamoil annuncia “misure per il contenimento dei prezzi” fino al 31 ottobre

en.title: Fuel, Tamoil also announces "measures to contain prices" until 31 October
en.summary: Tamoil announced price containment measures for fuel through October 31, following government negotiations with the petroleum group and Libyan authorities, though no specific price ceiling was disclosed.

stories.title: Casa a Montecarlo, la procura generale chiede la prescrizione per Fini e i Tulliani

en.title: Monaco apartment, prosecutor general requests statute of limitations for Fini and the Tullians
en.summary: The prosecutor general of Rome's Court of Appeal upheld the first-instance verdict but requested dismissal based on statute of limitations for the defendants in a case regarding a Monaco property. A decision is expected in February.

stories.title: Meloni su sentenza Regeni: “Già Gentiloni prima del mio Governo aveva riaperto relazioni con Egitto”

en.title: Meloni on Regeni verdict: "Gentiloni had already reopened relations with Egypt before my Government"
en.summary: Prime Minister Meloni responded to a court verdict regarding Giulio Regeni by noting that diplomatic relations with Egypt had been reestablished under the previous administration. Regeni's family called for immediate enforcement of compensation without waiting for the trial to conclude.

stories.title: Salone Nautico, al taglio del nastro solo Meloni e Bucci, esclusa Salis. E la premier le telefona

en.title: Boat Show, only Meloni and Bucci at ribbon-cutting, Salis excluded. And the premier calls her
en.summary: At a boat show opening ceremony, Prime Minister Meloni and another official appeared while the local mayor was excluded from the stage. Meloni questioned organizers about the mayor's absence and subsequently telephoned her.

stories.title: Meloni al Salone Nautico: “Difendiamo questa eccellenza”. Esclusa la sindaca Salis

en.title: Meloni at Boat Show: "Let's defend this excellence". Mayor Salis excluded
en.summary: Prime Minister Meloni spoke to media about supporting the boat industry's economic benefits and job creation at a nautical exhibition. The local mayor did not participate in the opening ceremony or ribbon-cutting.

stories.title: Usa, la Corte Suprema dà il via libera all’esecuzione di Christa Pike, ma lei sopravvive a due iniezioni. Ricoverata in ospedale

en.title: USA, Supreme Court clears way for execution of Christa Pike, but she survives two injections. Hospitalized
en.summary: The U.S. Supreme Court authorized the execution of a 50-year-old woman convicted for a crime committed as a teenager, but she survived two injection attempts and was hospitalized. The state governor subsequently suspended her death sentence.

en.title: Ambienta bets on Norwegian aquaculture
en.summary: Ambienta Sgr, an investment firm founded by Nino Tronchetti Provera focused on sustainability, has acquired Norwegian aquaculture companies BioMarine, Flatsetsund Engineering, and Smir through its Ambienta IV fund.

stories.title: Materie prime critiche, la filiera per il riciclo si ferma a metà

en.title: Critical raw materials, recycling chain stalls halfway
en.summary: Valuable metals found in smartphones, solar panels, and electric vehicle batteries are mostly purchased by Europe from abroad. Recovery is technically possible but currently occurs at limited levels.

stories.title: Mobilità connessa, presentate a Torino le demo del progetto europeo ENVELOPE

en.title: Connected mobility, ENVELOPE European project demos presented in Turin
en.summary: Prototypes of the ENVELOPE project demonstrate dynamic accident reconstruction using autonomous vehicles, autonomous map updates, vehicle-to-vehicle information exchange, and autonomous reconfiguration of connected vehicles in circulation.

stories.title: Silicon Box, via libera di Invitalia all’investimento da 3,2 miliardi a Novara

en.title: Silicon Box, Invitalia approves 3.2 billion euro investment in Novara
en.summary: Invitalia approved a major investment in the Silicon Box project in Novara, with 1.3 billion euros in public funding allocated. The initiative aims to accelerate permits and begin construction in spring.

en.title: Mechanical engineering hits new record abroad
en.summary: Mechanical engineering exports are reaching new peaks in 2026, with major markets including the United States, China, France, Germany, Saudi Arabia, the United Kingdom, and Spain.
